prospective_amendment: 2026-09-12: supersedes campaign-3.0 planning for future work following the owner's clarification. Rapid learning is command elapsed time to independently evaluated real competence; compute, experience and inherited costs are distinct. Historical studies and source-pinned protocols retain their original definitions.

campaigns.budget: focused fault tests plus one full suite per coherent milestone
campaigns.gate: source/evidence identity, truthful counters, atomic checkpoint and host safeguards
campaigns.stop: fix a specific failing contract before dependent work

campaigns.gate: 10 consecutive scored successes, 10/12 scored, zero unintended actions/manual interventions
campaigns.stop: any guard fault/effect, then bounded diagnosis; do not count exploratory sessions as study

campaigns.gate: 30 accounted attempts, zero safety faults/intervention; report all availability and wait costs
campaigns.stop: first safety fault or deadline; no set-and-forget claim from short gate alone

campaigns.gate: synchronized controls and complete varied runs; benchmark never used for training
campaigns.stop: request additional coverage only from measured gaps

campaigns.gate: installation, articulation/contact stability, offscreen timing and unchanged solver semantics
campaigns.stop: reject unstable or unsupported candidates; no real-fidelity claim

requires: fidelity identity and physics/render/learning cost budget
campaigns.gate: heldout geometry/dynamics/perception plus early real transfer probes and useful real progress per total cost
campaigns.stop: after each failure identify layer-specific bottleneck; never tune heldout labels; raw FPS cannot select fidelity

campaigns.gate: independent frozen evaluation and improvement per total cost
campaigns.stop: reject unproductive method after screen; change a specific bottleneck before repeating

requires: frozen arm parameters and noninferiority margins
campaigns.gate: unique score attribution and matched outcome/hacking comparisons
campaigns.stop: do not extend arms that violate declared distance/survival/coverage constraints

requires: committed concrete arm source and full accounting manifest
campaigns.gate: target status per seed, sampling uncertainty/censoring, full distributions and separate command/evaluation/inherited costs
campaigns.stop: deadline, no extra updates or outcome-selected replacements; publish measured shortfall and incomplete coverage

requires: profile-specific targets and matched total budget registration
campaigns.gate: zero-shot/adaptation/retention across map, vehicle, and pair
campaigns.stop: record content blockers; no purchases; no broad training before reference competence
